name: Uncle Joe’s Tavern
description: If one were to pinpoint the center of black market trade, it would be Uncle Joe’s tavern. There, it is possible to find a variety of unique items, typically offered by members of factions such as the Third Eye, Bloodbound, and The Dragon Syndicate. Located on a small island of the Fire Archipelago, it is a meeting place not just for pirates, but also for many members of various organizations. It is forbidden to fight inside the island, especially in the tavern and its luxurious inn. Uncle Joe, a retired and good-humored pirate, enjoys brokering deals over a hearty banquet. He deals in magic items and vessels, buying, selling, or even renting them, meticulously recording all transactions and basic customer information. The island is heavily guarded by creatures such as ogres, giants, and kobolds, as well as beings summoned by his artifacts, like rakshasas and other strange entities.
